name: response-standard
description: A controlled-language standard for how an agent writes to one person, derived from ASD-STE100 and extended with per-person preferences for answer shape, depth, evidence, and tone. Ships the applied standard plus the interview that regenerates it for a different reader. Use when the user asks how you should talk to them, wants replies restyled, or wants to build their own response standard. Trigger on: /response-standard, /build-response-standard, "how should you talk to me", "apply my response standard", "build my response standard", "simplified technical english".
